# ECB Portugal mortgage cost of borrowing (MIR)

This record covers the official European Central Bank (ECB) statistical series
for the cost of household borrowing for house purchase in Portugal, new
business, compiled by Banco de Portugal within the European System of Central
Banks (ESCB).

## Source and series

- Series key: `MIR.M.PT.B.A2C.AM.R.A.2250.EUR.N`.
- Source: [ECB Data API CSV response](https://data-api.ecb.europa.eu/service/data/MIR/M.PT.B.A2C.AM.R.A.2250.EUR.N?format=csvdata).
- Research consumer: [`portugal-housing-generations` v1.0.0](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/portugal-housing-generations/tree/0407faed1f08209b3d7682e19fc57e7120e62879).
- Attribution: **Source: ECB statistics**, with the series key and reference period.

The research project retrieved an unmodified CSV on 29 October 2026. Its
[source inventory](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/portugal-housing-generations/blob/0407faed1f08209b3d7682e19fc57e7120e62879/docs/data-sources.csv)
records the request URL, retrieval timestamp, and last-update header; its
[SHA-256 manifest](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/portugal-housing-generations/blob/0407faed1f08209b3d7682e19fc57e7120e62879/data/SHA256SUMS)
pins the response bytes. That project-local file hash is not an ECB-issued
immutable version identifier.

## Licence and registry decision

Under the [ESCB policy regarding reuse of statistics](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/ecb_statistics/governance_and_quality_framework/html/usage_policy.en.html),
publicly released statistics may be reused free of charge when their source is
quoted. The policy applies to standard statistical products and does not
authorize arbitrary modification or reuse of unrelated ECB material.

**Metadata-only external record.** The upstream ECB API remains authoritative.
The pinned research CSV remains in its project; no additional copies or
canonical dataset contracts are introduced here.
